standard_prerequisites.name: A morphism from an affine scheme to a scheme with affine diagonal is affine
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes each affine open U -> X an affine morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: The affine pushforward lemma verifies the coherator hypothesis of the abstract argument lemma

core_obligations: Take an affine open U of X; the morphism U -> X is affine by the morphisms affine-permanence lemma (proof lines 1813-1815).
Thus the hypothesis of the argument lemma holds by the affine pushforward lemma, and the comparison functor of the equation is an equivalence with quasi-inverse RQ_X (proof lines 1816-1817).
proof_roadmap: Show the maps from affine opens are affine (proof lines 1813-1815).
Apply the abstract comparison lemma with the affine pushforward input (proof lines 1816-1817).
